notes: Timing values are measurements, not interval certificates.
Interrupted phase values stop at the retained checkpoint and do not claim a complete total including discarded tails.
Construction proposals never determine mathematical acceptance; the frozen certificate is replayed independently.
Bulk group construction and the weighted refit have cumulative timings covering their resumed runs.
